text:
Liz Chen: Quick sync — aiming to GA the new Inference Gateway on Nov 15. Need final signoff on SLA targets, docs handoffs, oncall coverage, monitoring alerts, and pricing SKUs. I'll paste the current checklist below.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Can you call out which SLAs are non-negotiable for GA?

Liz Chen: Non-negotiable: uptime SLA + latency SLOs per tier. Proposal: `SLA uptime = 99.95%` for Dedicated and Hosted Tier-A; `p95 latency <= 120ms` for small text-gen models; `p95 latency <= 40ms` for embeddings. Anything else we should lock?

Rajiv Menon: Agree on uptime. Add an SLO for error rate: `5xx rate < 0.1% (rolling 1h)` — important for customer SLAs. Also need fallback policy documented (model variant / region).

Maria Gomez: Docs/status: I have a draft GA doc (internal) and a separate customer-facing FAQ. Posting links: internal -> https://confluence.redwood/example-ga-inference-gw (draft), public FAQ -> https://docs.redwood.com/faq-inference-gw (staging). I need final bullet points for pricing SKUs by EOD Wednesday.

Liz Chen: Pricing ask: keep 3 SKUs (dev, standard, enterprise). Dev and standard are usage-based; enterprise gets reserved throughput + SLA. Samir, can you confirm rate-limits & burst policy for standard?

Samir Patel: For standard: soft QPS limit 100, burst to 300 for 30s, then throttled. I'll add that to the pricing doc and include an example billing calc.

Rajiv Menon: Monitoring: add the following alerts to the GA runbook: sustained p95 breach > 5m, error-rate spike (>0.5% 5m), throughput saturation > 90% for 10m. Attach runbook links and oncall steps.

Maria Gomez: Oncall: we need 24/7 primary with a 4h SLA for ticket ack for Enterprise customers. Who owns the rotation? ops-team? ops-bot, can you create the rotation stub?

ops-bot: Created calendar stub "IGW GA oncall rotation" and a runbook page under /runbooks/igw-ga; assigned provisional owners: Rajiv, Samir, +1. Reminder set for runbook review Wed 10:30 PT.

Liz Chen: Outstanding items checklist (short):
- Finalize SLA numbers (owner: Samir)
- Error-rate SLO + fallback policy (owner: Rajiv)
- Public pricing SKUs + examples (owner: Maria)
- Docs: release notes + customer FAQ (owner: Maria)
- Runbook + oncall rota (owner: Rajiv)
- Monitoring alerts wired to PagerDuty + dashboard (owner: Samir)

Samir Patel: I'll update the SLA PR and the dashboard today. Expect a PR link by 5pm PT.

Maria Gomez: I'll convert the internal GA doc to public-ready after we lock pricing. ETA Thu morning.

Liz Chen: Thanks. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when their item is green. If any blockers, shout now so we can triage in the runbook review on Wed.

Rajiv Menon: :white_check_mark: for runbook and fallback policy (will post PR with steps)

Samir Patel: :white_check_mark: for SLA/dashboard (PR incoming)

Maria Gomez: :white_check_mark: for docs/pricing draft (will move to public after Samir's numbers)

ops-bot: release-bot scheduled a smoke window for Nov 14 02:00–03:00 UTC (pre-GA smoke).

Liz Chen: Great — closing the loop here. We'll meet Wed 10:30 PT to finalize. If anything changes before then, drop updates in this thread. Thanks all.
